summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a Board meeting scheduled for May 20, 2026, to consider and approve its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. The disclosure is made via a Hong Kong exchange announcement but filed as a 6-K with the SEC. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is involved. The filing contains no terms, prices, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics.
